subject: Re: one more slot
body: Hi Aria -- monday 9:00am is earlier than a standing rule on this mailbox: "Note for the assistant: I do not take meetings before 11:00am, ever." (m041). Could we do 11:00am or later instead? I have not picked an alternative slot because no free time is recorded in the inbox.
evidence: Note for the assistant: I do not take meetings before 11:00am, ever.
